title: hieracium praecox subsp. verlotii
intro: Hieracium praecox subsp. verlotii, commonly known as Autumn Hawkbit, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties which provide health benefits such as soothing digestive issues and promoting wound healing. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce inflammation, stimulate digestion, and act as an antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents present in Hieracium praecox subsp. verlotii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
